categories.main_business_segments: Ganfeng Lithium operates across the lithium industry value chain, including upstream lithium resource development, midstream lithium salt deep processing and lithium metal smelting, downstream lithium battery manufacturing, and retired lithium battery recycling. The company produces a wide range of lithium compounds and metal lithium products, lithium-ion batteries, solid-state batteries, and energy storage systems. It also engages in lithium battery recycling and resource recovery, serving multiple end markets such as electric vehicles, energy storage, aerospace, functional materials, and pharmaceuticals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including proprietary processes for lithium extraction from spodumene, brine, and lithium clay. It has developed mature production technologies for battery-grade lithium hydroxide, lithium carbonate, lithium chloride, and lithium metal products. Ganfeng is a leader in solid-state battery technology, producing high ionic conductivity solid electrolytes and ultra-thin lithium metal anodes. It also utilizes lean manufacturing and automation to optimize production efficiency and product quality. The company actively invests in R&D for new lithium extraction methods, high-purity lithium processing, and battery recycling technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ganfeng serves global blue-chip customers primarily in the electric vehicle battery supply chain, including leading battery cathode material manufacturers, battery suppliers, and automotive OEMs such as LG Chem, Tesla, and BMW. Its products are widely used in electric vehicles, energy storage systems, consumer electronics, aerospace, and pharmaceutical industries. The company’s diversified customer base spans over 10 countries, ensuring broad market coverage and reducing dependency on any single customer or region.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with lithium resource projects and production facilities in China (Jiangxi, Qinghai, Inner Mongolia, Sichuan), Australia, Argentina, Mexico, Ireland, Mali, and other African countries. It operates production bases for lithium compounds and metal lithium mainly in China, with battery manufacturing sites in Jiangxi, Guangdong, Chongqing, and Jiangsu provinces. Overseas lithium resource development is significant, including major projects in Australia, Argentina, and Africa. Sales markets include China, Japan, South Korea, Germany, and other countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ganfeng Lithium operates a vertically integrated supply chain covering upstream lithium mining and resource development, midstream lithium chemical processing and metal lithium production, downstream lithium-ion battery manufacturing, and end-of-life lithium battery recycling. This integration allows the company to control raw material supply, production quality, and customer relationships across the entire lithium battery ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes expanding global lithium resource reserves, especially focusing on low-cost brine resources and spodumene projects. It invests heavily in capacity expansion for lithium chemical products and metal lithium, as well as solid-state battery technology development. R&D efforts target high-energy-density batteries, solid electrolytes, lithium metal anodes, battery recycling technologies, and energy storage solutions. Ganfeng also emphasizes digitalization and intelligent manufacturing to improve operational efficiency and cost control.
categories.revenue_model: Ganfeng generates revenue primarily through direct sales of lithium compounds, metal lithium products, lithium-ion batteries, and energy storage systems. The company mainly uses a direct sales model with self-determined pricing, serving industrial customers and OEMs. It also earns income from lithium battery recycling services and investment income from equity holdings. The company engages in commodity futures hedging to manage price volatility risks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ganfeng is a world-leading lithium chemical and metal lithium producer, holding a top global position in metal lithium production capacity. It is one of the few companies with industrialized technologies for lithium extraction from brine, spodumene, and recycling. The company maintains strong competitive advantages through vertical integration, stable raw material supply, advanced technology, and strategic partnerships with global battery and automotive leaders. Competitors include other major lithium producers and battery manufacturers globally, but Ganfeng’s comprehensive product portfolio and global resource base position it as a market leader.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Ganfeng reported revenue of approximately RMB 18.9 billion, a 42.66% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.07 billion. Total assets reached RMB 1.008 trillion, up 9.96% year-over-year, while shareholders’ equity was RMB 417.8 billion, down 11.17%. The company’s cash flow from operations improved significantly. Despite short-term market challenges and price declines, Ganfeng continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, aiming for a total lithium product supply capacity of no less than 600,000 tons LCE by 2030.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ganfeng offers a comprehensive lithium product portfolio with over 40 types of lithium compounds and metal lithium products, enabling it to meet diverse customer needs. Its vertical integration across the lithium value chain ensures stable, high-quality raw material supply and cost advantages. The company’s advanced technologies in lithium extraction, solid-state batteries, and battery recycling provide competitive differentiation. Strategic partnerships with global industry leaders and a broad geographic presence enhance its market resilience and innovation capability, positioning Ganfeng as a reliable and innovative lithium ecosystem supplier.
